# toml++

Vendored single-header TOML parser and serializer for C++17.

- **Source**: https://github.com/marzer/tomlplusplus
- **Version**: 3.4.0
- **License**: MIT (see [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt))
- **File**: [include/toml++/toml.hpp](include/toml++/toml.hpp)

Kept unmodified. Will be used by the `ntrickled` daemon for TOML configuration parsing.
